issue.title: Qute parser - fix handling of extra whitespaces before end delimiters

body:
Ideally, users should avoid using whitespaces before/after braces.

Case 1 - we try to be lenient and ignore the whitespaces before the closing brace
Case 2 - shouldn't fail, we should be lenient as well, it's a bug 
Case 3 - this is expected, see https://quarkus.io/guides/qute-reference#identifiers
Case 4 - a bug too

I've created https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/pull/8179 to fix the bugs.

@xorye Thanks for spotting this!
